heroHeadline: We don't ask whether the ticket is closed. We ask whether the problem is solved, and whether the citizen was free to say so.
heroSub: Redressa audits every civic grievance at the moment it is raised, writes a binding Expectation Contract, enforces structured departmental replies, and refuses closure until verified on the ground.
disclaimer: Redressa is an autonomous AI agent. Every action is logged and you can contest any verdict in one tap. An independent reviewer audits decisions.
